column1: # Internal-term table for scripts/check_terms.py. One row per term, tab-separated.
# class follows the four treatments of 文化庁「公用文作成の考え方」(2022) II-2/II-3:
#   keep        standard term; use as is, never paraphrase it away
#   keep+gloss  keep the term and explain it at its first use, in the same or the next sentence
#   replace     in-house or coined word; write use_instead (or the real name)
#   avoid       do not use; name what it refers to instead
#   off         (override files only) disable a row of this table for one project
# pattern is optional: a Python regular expression used instead of the literal term,
# for terms that are also ordinary words (家 inside 専門家 is not the in-house word).
# Per-project rows: .plain-japanese/terms.tsv at the project root, PLAIN_JAPANESE_TERMS, or --terms.

column2: refers_to
column4: use_instead
